name: EEG Seizure Detection
desc: Developed a cutting-edge seizure detection algorithm using Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), applying Python and MATLAB.
features: Automated seizure detection from raw EEG signals
SVM and ANN classifiers with comparative analysis
Feature extraction using bandpass filtering and FFT
Achieved high sensitivity and specificity on benchmark datasets

name: FAQ Chatbot for Faculty Support
desc: Designed and developed an advanced FAQ chatbot system to enhance faculty support, utilizing natural language processing, Google Workspace, and LLMs.
features: Intent recognition and entity extraction with BERT-based NLP
Integration with Google Workspace APIs for dynamic data retrieval
Multi-turn conversation handling and context retention
Deployed with REST API backend for real-time faculty queries

name: Cloud Monitoring App
desc: A cloud monitoring app for AWS that provides real-time insights into CPU and memory utilization across AWS infrastructure.
features: Real-time CPU and memory utilization dashboards for AWS EC2
CloudWatch metrics integration with configurable alert thresholds
Containerized with Docker and deployed on Kubernetes (EKS)
Auto-scaling policies triggered by resource utilization metrics
